name: IMPERIALE WOODWORK LLC
old_description: "Rest assured your complete satisfaction will never be compromised."
about:
Imperiale Woodwork LLC operates from Milford, Connecticut, where founder Vinicius Manerba opened the business to the public in early 2016. Manerba had spent roughly a decade specializing in furniture and hardwood flooring before launching the company, which focuses on custom, hand-crafted heirloom pieces.

The shop produces custom furniture with a concentration on live edge tables — dining, conference, and occasional tables — using hundreds of locally sourced hardwood slabs kept in stock. Each piece is hand crafted, from slab selection through final finishing, with an emphasis on preserving the natural character of the wood.

The company serves clients seeking one-of-a-kind tables for residential and commercial settings, including homeowners, designers, and businesses furnishing conference rooms. Projects are collaborative, with the team working directly with customers to match slabs to specific design visions.

Imperiale Woodwork was founded on the mission of saving fallen trees and returning them to life as functional furniture. Manerba describes the work as a passion for live edge design and a commitment to creating pieces that can be passed down through generations.
